upstreamNativeBuild: Official generated wasm2js fallback; not locally recompiled from C. Upstream build instructions in external/openjpeg/README.md; source https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js.openjpeg/
localAdapter: Remove outer async and final await; replace private run with synchronous init (only warn option is exposed, no async init/status hooks).
Embed unchanged native wasm2js body within existing private oi factory.
Bridge synchronous decode using malloc/write/jp2_decode(numComponents,indexed,smask,reduce0,padComponents)/free; clear owned image/error fields on completion.
PDFImage uses last filter and actual numComps, with DeviceRGBA requesting automatic RGBA output.
sync: node scripts/sync_pdf_openjpeg.cjs; --check compares generated factory bytes
